acceptance_instructions: DRAFT written offline 2026-10-11. To accept: Ahmet reviews weights/rules below, then set status=accepted, weights_status=accepted, verified=true, accepted_by=ahmet@gamechangers.com.tr, accepted_at=<ISO time with timezone>, evidence_ref=<where the decision is recorded>, rights_declaration.accepted=true. Any edit changes the policy digest; earlier assessments/approvals stop matching. While not accepted every submission is quality_held and the 3 managers are tagged.
scope_note: TECHNICAL conformance only, measured by v11_artifact_inspector on the actual downloaded bytes (file type, byte size, pixel dimensions, OCR literal text) against the brief. A score is NOT artistic, brand-design or copy quality. Internal Gamechangers works only; WAT/customers stay off.
single_file_scope: v1 assesses and delivers exactly one final file (brief with one final deliverable, quantity 1, image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf or text/plain). Multi-file, video/animation, PSD/ZIP submissions are held for a human.

criteria.description: Dosya biçimi ve boyutu (MIME imzası brief biçimlerinden biri; bayt sınırı içinde)
criteria.measure: inspector checks mime_type + size_bytes; both pass = 100, any fail = 0, unknown = unassessed
inspector fact:width + fact:height vs brief width/height; score = passed/2*100. Brief without width/height = unassessed (hold, not a free 100)

criteria.description: Brief'te birebir istenen metinler dosyada (OCR / PDF / TXT)
criteria.measure: literal match of each brief required_text (only literals that appear in the request mail); score = found/total*100. Brief without required_text = unassessed. OCR failure = unassessed

criteria.description: Brief'teki çıktı türü ve adediyle teslim edilen dosya uyumu
criteria.measure: exactly one supported file for the single final deliverable and kind matches (graphic->image, text->pdf/txt); 100 or 0

critical_checks.brand_identity: OCR/text contains one of brand_literals -> passed; otherwise unassessed (human). Never failed by absence.
critical_checks.technical_specs: mime_type, size_bytes and (when the brief states them) width/height all pass -> passed; any fail -> failed
critical_checks.rights_and_disclosure: passed only when rights_declaration.accepted=true (internal work, Gamechangers-owned assets); otherwise unassessed
critical_checks.internal_notes_excluded: failed if any forbidden_literals is detected; otherwise passed by construction: delivery attaches only the producer's downloaded bytes with a fixed template body, never comment text

rights_declaration.text: Gamechangers iç işlerinde kullanılan varlıklar Gamechangers'a aittir veya iç kullanım için onaylıdır.

band_examples.all_measured_pass: 100 -> delivery candidate (still needs send authority, recipients/CC, file re-download, stop checks)
band_examples.one_of_three_required_texts_missing: 15+25+26.66668+20 = 86.66668 (criterion scores to 4 decimals) -> 80-89, one of Özge/Ahmet/Cansu must approve

open_decisions_for_ahmet: Weights 15/25/40/20 and the 90/80 thresholds for internal works.
Whether a brief without dimensions or required text may score those criteria as passed (currently unassessed -> hold).
Brand identity rule: OCR brand literal or human (currently unassessed when no literal is detected).
